title: Derivation and Validation of a Prediction Model for Predicting the 5-Year Incidence of Type 2 Diabetes in Non-Obese Adults: A Population-Based Cohort Study
source: Original source.pdf and source.fulltext.xml; identity checks recorded by main agent in metadata.json
contribution: Six-predictor Cox nomogram for 5-year incident T2D among non-obese Japanese health-check participants, with random internal validation.
method: Derivation LASSO selection (10-fold lambda CV; family ambiguous) → multivariable Cox → nomogram
best_metric: Internal validation 5-year AUC 0.829 (95%CI 0.753–0.905), Results p. 2094; C-index0.837 (0.760–0.914), Table 3 p. 2095
vs_baseline: No verified same-cohort head-to-head baseline. Historical Discussion comparisons do not establish superiority. Not numerically comparable with Paper_01_NHANES_NoLab cross-sectional no-lab screening.
gap: No external/temporal validation; whole-cohort DCA and incomplete executable reporting; 47 holdout events.
verdict_reason: Useful first reading and conditional reconstruction for a true 5-year prognosis task; exact replication and clinical transportability are unestablished.

reasons: Direct5-year incident-T2D question in a baseline diabetes-free cohort.
Reports cohort/events, selected predictors, discrimination, calibration and DCA for critical reading.
limitations: Random internal split only; selected Japanese health-check population.
Whole-cohort DCA, incomplete bootstrap operationalization and source inconsistencies limit inference.

reasons: Public data package and core method make conditional reconstruction B promising once data are verified.
limitations: Workbook/codebook retrieval and inspection pending after automated 403.
No verified original code/seed; candidate-count/family and full absolute-risk specification unresolved.

notes: Public Dryad package is cited: 10.5061/dryad.8q0p192. Main-agent automated workbook retrieval returned403; workbook/codebook remain uninspected. Public availability is documented, not disproved by403.
No verified original code repository, split seed or executable specification. Code availability is UNKNOWN, not proven nonexistent.
Learning route B is conditional same-data method reconstruction after obtaining and verifying original data/codebook; not exact numerical replication.
18/19 count, LASSO family, encoding/standardization, final Cox coefficients and baseline survival are unresolved.
Conceptual mapping does not establish transportability to Paper_01_NHANES_NoLab: its target is cross-sectional no-lab screening.

claim_provenance.claim: Secondary historical cohort analysis used NAGALA health-check data from Murakami Memorial Hospital, Gifu, Japan, obtained via Dryad.

location.section: Materials and Methods — Data Source; Study Population

claim_provenance.claim: The analysis included 12,940 participants and 201 incident T2D events; derivation n=9651/events=154 and validation n=3289/events=47.

location.section: Results — Characteristics of the Derivation and Validation Cohorts

claim_provenance.claim: Median follow-up was 2016 days overall, 1972 days in derivation and 2131 days in validation.

location.section: Results — Characteristics of the Derivation and Validation Cohorts

claim_provenance.claim: Incident T2D during follow-up was defined by FPG >=126 mg/dL, HbA1c >=48 mmol/mol or self-report.
Participants with missing covariates were excluded; obesity was defined with BMI 25 kg/m2 as the cutoff.

location.section: Materials and Methods — Study Population; Definitions

claim_provenance.claim: The theoretical random split was 3:1. Lambda was selected using 10-fold cross-validation, followed by multivariable Cox regression.
The six selected baseline predictors were age, fatty liver, GGT, TG, HbA1c and FPG.

location.section: Results — Characteristics Selection by LASSO Regression Analysis

claim_provenance.claim: Table 2 reports LASSO coefficients and lambda.1se=0.0051; these are not final Cox coefficients or baseline survival.

location.section: Results — Characteristics Selection by LASSO Regression Analysis

claim_provenance.claim: Results refers to 18 indicators whereas the Figure 2 caption refers to 19 features and uses the phrase partial likelihood deviance (binomial deviance).

location.section: Results — Characteristics Selection by LASSO Regression Analysis

claim_provenance.claim: Derivation C-index was 0.906 (95% CI 0.878–0.934); internal validation C-index was 0.837 (95% CI 0.760–0.914).

location.section: Results — Model Performance for Derivation and Validation Cohort

claim_provenance.claim: Five-year AUC was 0.916 (95% CI 0.889–0.943) in derivation and 0.829 (95% CI 0.753–0.905) in validation.

location.section: Results — Model Performance for Derivation and Validation Cohort

claim_provenance.claim: Calibration curves were presented for both cohorts; the reported Hosmer–Lemeshow test had P >0.05.

location.section: Results — Model Performance for Derivation and Validation Cohort

claim_provenance.claim: The Methods report 1000 bootstrap resamplings for C-index, ROC, calibration and DCA to reduce overfitting bias; a complete refit-based optimism-correction algorithm is not specified there.
DCA used the whole cohort and reported more net benefit than both default strategies over thresholds 1%–69.5%.

location.section: Results — Clinical Usefulness of the Predicting Nomogram

claim_provenance.claim: Study Population gives 2004–2015; Figure 1 gives registration May 1, 1994–December 31, 2016.

location.section: Materials and Methods — Study Population; Results — Characteristics of the Derivation and Validation Cohorts

claim_provenance.claim: The authors acknowledge no OGTT ascertainment, complete-case selection and the need for external validation in other populations.
The validation cohort constitutes external validation.
The study demonstrates that implementing the nomogram reduces diabetes incidence or health-care costs.
The cohort establishes a causal biological mechanism linking GGT or fatty liver to diabetes.

rob_audit.evidence_ref: Statistical Analyses p. 2090; Table 1 p. 2092; Results p. 2094; Figures 6–7 pp. 2096–2097
rob_audit.notes: No confirmed B–G leakage from inspected paper. Empty leakage_types is not proof that uninspected code is leakage-free. Whole-cohort DCA includes derivation subjects; 1000 bootstraps alone do not establish complete optimism correction. Baseline glycemic biomarkers predicting future T2D are not inherently leakage. This mini-audit is not a full PROBAST assessment.

probes.definition: Genuine holdout or nested CV; tuning separated from testing
probes.finding: Random internal holdout exists. LASSO/Cox are described in derivation. Actual data flow and split seed remain unverified. A genuine held-out test does not automatically require nested CV.

probes.definition: Feature selection isolated from final test; fold placement
probes.finding: LASSO is described in derivation with 10-fold lambda CV. Per-fold preprocessing and executable workflow are unclear; no demonstrated whole-cohort selection.
probes.evidence_ref: Abstract p. 2087; Statistical Analyses p. 2090; Results pp. 2091–2093

probes.finding: Oversampling/SMOTE is not reported. No pre-split resampling violation is demonstrated.
Curves and H–L P>0.05 are reported; slope/intercept are Not reported; censoring-aware calibration implementation is Unclear. Non-significant H–L does not establish equivalence.
Only random internal validation. Authors acknowledge further external validation is needed.

probes.definition: Label-defining biomarkers in features, adjudicated using timing
probes.finding: FPG/HbA1c are baseline predictors of later incident disease. The same analytes at distinct timepoints are not automatically target leakage. Actual workbook timing remains unverified.
probes.evidence_ref: Data Source; Definitions pp. 2089–2090; Table 2 p. 2093

probes.definition: Complex survey weights, strata and PSU
probes.finding: NAGALA hospital health-check cohort is not a NHANES/BRFSS probability survey.

peer_review_crosswalk.finding: Concern: whole-cohort DCA includes derivation. Complete refit/optimism correction is unclear.
Not applicable to a negative incremental-value claim; no nested-model incremental-value comparison established.

peer_review_crosswalk.definition: Events per variable in each model
peer_review_crosswalk.finding: 154 derivation events/6 final listed predictors =25.7 events per listed predictor (analyst arithmetic). Candidate screening and coding complexity also matter. Holdout has 47 events.

peer_review_crosswalk.definition: Net benefit is not policy endorsement
peer_review_crosswalk.finding: DCA does not demonstrate reduced incidence, costs or strategy effectiveness.
No confirmed mismatch in text: selected predictors are baseline. Workbook timing not verified.
Random split is internal. CV/bootstrap do not constitute external validation.

survival_specific_findings.detail: No PH diagnostic found in inspected Methods/Results; no proven violation either.
Time-to-event and time-dependent ROC described; exact estimator, package and censoring adjustment are not fully operationalized.
Nomogram and rounded HRs given; exact final coefficients, centering and baseline survival are not verified as a full executable specification.
